blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Small talk is easy. It helps us feel close to other people. On Monday morning we all ask the same question: "How was your weekend?"

Today we answer with like + -ing. We say: I like walking. I enjoy cooking. I love spending time with my family. These are short, simple sentences.

You do not need big words. Take your time. Every sentence counts. Small talk is where trust begins.

items.q: What question do we ask on Monday morning?
items.why: "On Monday morning we all ask the same question: How was your weekend?"

items.q: How do we answer today?
items.why: "Today we answer with like + -ing."

items.q: Which sentence is an example from the text?
items.why: O texto dá o exemplo "I like walking."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: Small talk helps us feel close.
You need big words for small talk.
How was your weekend? is a good question.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "You do not need big words", então discordaria disso.

items.q: "Small talk is where trust begins" suggests that…
options: small talk can build good relationships
we should not talk on Monday
items.why: Inferência: se a confiança começa na small talk, ela ajuda a criar boas relações.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver falar sobre o fim de semana dele. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, my name is Oliver. I work at Czarnikow. It is Monday morning, and I want to tell you about my weekend.

On Saturday I like resting. I stay at home and I drink coffee. In the afternoon, I like walking in the park. It is quiet and nice. I love the fresh air.

On Sunday I spend time with my family. We enjoy watching movies together. My son loves football, so he plays in the garden. My wife likes reading her book.

In the evening we cook dinner. I love cooking pasta. It is my favourite. After dinner, we talk and we laugh.

I like my weekends because they are simple. I rest, I walk, and I am with my family. On Monday I come to work happy. How was your weekend? Please tell me!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Oliver work?
items.why: "I work at Czarnikow."

items.q: What does Oliver like doing on Saturday?
items.why: "On Saturday I like resting. I stay at home."

items.q: What does the family enjoy doing on Sunday?
items.why: "We enjoy watching movies together."

items.q: Oliver's weekend suggests that he…
options: likes a calm and simple life
items.why: Inferência: ele descansa, caminha e fica com a família — gosta de uma vida simples e calma.

items.q: Why does Oliver come to work happy on Monday?
options: Because he had a good, restful weekend
Because he does not like weekends
items.why: Inferência: um fim de semana simples e bom com descanso e família o deixa feliz na segunda.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I have two free days at the weekend." A weekend is…
items.why: Weekend = fim de semana (sábado e domingo).

items.q: "I like to walk in the park." A walk is…
items.why: Walk = caminhada / caminhar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "On Sunday we watch a good ___ at home."
items.why: Movie = filme, o que assistimos em casa.

items.q: "I love my family." Family means…
items.why: Family = família.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I am tired. I need some ___ on Saturday."
items.why: Rest = descanso, o que precisamos quando estamos cansados.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de conversa no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "How was your weekend?" This question asks about…
items.why: É a pergunta clássica de segunda-feira sobre o fim de semana.

items.q: "I spend time with my family on Sunday." To spend time with someone means to…
items.why: Spend time with = passar tempo junto com alguém.

items.q: "Let's catch up on Monday." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar a conversa em dia, trocar novidades.

items.q: "I like to relax at the weekend." To relax means to…
items.why: Relax = relaxar, descansar e ficar calmo.

items.q: "See you Monday. Take care!" Take care means…
items.why: Take care = cuide-se; uma despedida gentil.
